mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds consistently across monetary policy cycles without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% in any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling does not produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer demand regime (HOUST and RSAFS above 75th percentile), rising housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust economic activity that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 75th percentile, or Rank IC for joint condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing output and economic growth, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This is a persistent supply-side signal without regime dependence.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO predicting 60-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals weak residential construction and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST is below 1400.0 in any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 3.5% annualized), rising consumer price inflation compresses real corporate profits and forces central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% in any 12-month period.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that supports strong consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE is below 4.0% in any 12-month period.
